params.body: First measurement with #175 on staging: the Stocklist list render is 1.5 s app of which 0.95 s database in 67 queries. To see which statements, an administrator can send the request header X-Timing-Detail; the response then carries X-Query-1..8 with duration and SQL (whitespace collapsed, 900 chars). Nothing changes for requests without that header.
params.title: Server-Timing: slowest queries on request
